encodings.note: EBX holds the authenticated code module physical base address. ECX holds the authenticated code module size (bytes).

exceptions.when: If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[ENTERACCS] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].

If CR0.CD = 1 or CR0.NW = 1 or CR0.NE = 0 or CR0.PE = 0 or CPL > 0 or EFLAGS.VM = 1. If a Intel(R) TXT-capable chipset is not present. If in VMX root operation. If the initiating processor is not designated as the bootstrap processor via the MSR bit IA32_APIC_BASE.BSP. If the processor is already in authenticated code execution mode. If the processor is in SMM. If a valid uncorrectable machine check error is logged in IA32_MC[I]_STATUS. If the authenticated code base is not on a 4096 byte boundary. If the authenticated code size > processor internal authenticated code area capacity. If the authenticated code size is not modulo 64. If other enabled logical processor(s) of the same package CR0.CD = 1. If other enabled logical processor(s) of the same package are not in the wait-for-SIPI or SENTER sleep state.
If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[ENTERACCS] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
GETSEC[ENTERACCS] is not recognized in real-address mode.
If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[ENTERACCS] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
GETSEC[ENTERACCS] is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
If AC code module does not reside in physical address below 2^32 -1.
